sources.facts: Goldschmidtstraße 12, Saxony monument 09290143. Late-Classical plastered rental house with sandstone trim, Felix Mendelssohn memorial, court building and pavement; early-twentieth-century conversion of a ground-floor opening to a shop.
German Foundation for Monument Protection lists the house at this address as 1844/45, with Mendelssohn family apartment on the first elevated floor.
Bach-Archiv Leipzig describes the surviving late-Classical house and Mendelssohn’s residence there from 1845 to 1847.
